resolution.plan: Transcribe the system prompt (Figure 4) and the base user prompt (Figure 5) from Appendix A of the PDF; the text extraction carries only the figure captions. The base configuration is 'Question | llm -> Code' (Table 1). Apply it to the first 100 LeetCode problems (lc100, Sec. 5.1.1) with gpt-4-turbo at temperature 0.7, top_p 1, max_tokens 4096, n=1, execute the returned code against the problems' test cases and compare the pass rate with 98% (Table 2, row gpt-4, column base).
